pages.title: Organisation settings
pages._note: The active organisation's overrides of the objection period, the anonymisation profile and the default huisstijl (multi-tenant-hardening REQ-DDMTH-007/-008). type:custom because the save goes through filinq's api/organisation-settings, which admits only an admin of the active organisation or an instance admin; the schema itself grants writes to instance admins only. Every member sees the page read-only.
